national_news.title: Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 Organized to Empower Artisans from Disadvantaged Communities
bullets: The Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is hosting the 15-day Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, New Delhi, under the theme 'प्रकाश और परंपरा – ज्योति से ज्योति जलाएँ'.

It provides a marketing platform for artisans belonging to Scheduled Castes (SCs), OBCs, Safai Karamcharis, and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) with participation from apex corporations like NSFDC, NBCFDC, NSKFDC, and NDFDC.
The Mela facilitates market access through digital integration via 'Bharat TULIP' and supports inclusive growth alongside platforms like 'Purple Fest'.

national_news.title: COP31 Climate Summit Commences in Antalya, Turkey
bullets: The 31st Conference of Parties (COP31) to the UNFCCC began in Antalya, Turkey, bringing together delegates from nearly 200 countries.
The summit aims to accelerate clean energy, scale up climate finance, and strengthen global climate resilience.
The World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) is scheduled to release its flagship State of Climate update 2026 during the conference.

bihar_news.title: PM to Inaugurate 19-km Six-Lane Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur Ganga Bridge in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the 19-km Kacchi Dargah-Bidupur six-lane Ganga bridge, aimed at establishing a strategic north-south road connectivity corridor in Bihar.
The mega-infrastructure project features a 9-km main cable-stayed/extradosed bridge across the Ganga River connecting Kacchi Dargah in Patna district with Bidupur in Vaishali district.
During the visit, the PM will also participate in an event at the Jafarpatti Industrial Area in Rajapakar block, Vaishali, focusing on industrial investment and employment creation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch 'Give It Up' Campaign for Free Power Subsidy Scheme
bullets: Bihar will launch a voluntary 'Give It Up' campaign on December 1, appealing to affluent citizens and income-tax payers to surrender their monthly 125 units of free electricity subsidy.

The free electricity benefit is executed under the Mukhyamantri Vidyut Upbhokta Sahayata Yojana, covering nearly 1.92 crore households at an annual cost of around Rs 23,000 crore to the state exchequer.
Funds saved through the voluntary surrender of electricity subsidies will be diverted toward upgrading state educational infrastructure and executing priority social welfare projects.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Health Department to Recruit 11,000 Staff Members
bullets: The State Health Society, Bihar (SHSB) is set to release a recruitment notification for over 11,000 healthcare positions in November.
The recruitment drive covers medical support, technical, administrative, and clerical posts across all 38 districts of Bihar.
The hiring process aims to address manpower shortages from district hospitals down to primary health centres (PHCs) and panchayat levels.
